formal_success_gate.mean_gate: For every metric, the candidate arithmetic mean must strictly exceed the largest arithmetic mean among all nine same-seed baselines; ties fail.
formal_success_gate.uncertainty_gate: For every metric, the paired candidate-minus-best-baseline BCa 95% confidence interval lower bound must be strictly greater than zero.
formal_success_gate.joint_rule: All three mean gates and all three uncertainty gates must pass; any failure forbids a formal-confirmation-success claim.
